blurb: Guests can enjoy guided vineyard tours with tastings, casual tastings on the patio, and seasonal patio dining among the vines. The estate operates seasonally with outdoor tasting areas open during warm months. A sister wine bar, Twin Muses, offers a year-round bistro experience nearby.
extraNote: Tours are not private and may include multiple groups up to 14 guests · Book at least 48 hours in advance for vineyard tour · No refunds available for vineyard tours · Patio and outdoor tastings open rain or shine; outdoor areas not heated · At the estate vineyard and patio in Carp, Ontario · May 15 through September (patio and outdoor tasting areas)
